about: The curated Milky Way record gal:milky_way (object framework section 18.7). Every number carries `src` (a key of `papers`) and `where`; the build refuses any number without both. The centre is not written here: `centre_from` names the bh-curated record whose position and distance the build copies from backend/data/sources/bh-curated/black_holes.json, so R0 exists once. The drawn look (a generic barred spiral) is illustrative; the sizes it is drawn to are the measured values below.
name: Milky Way

esa1997.cite: ESA 1997, The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, ESA SP-1200, Vol. 1

ngp_ra.where: Sec. 1.5.3, eq. 1.5.9: north galactic pole in ICRS, alpha_G = 192.85948 deg ('to be regarded as exact quantities')

l_node.where: Sec. 1.5.3, eq. 1.5.10: galactic longitude of the ascending node of the galactic plane on the ICRS equator, l_Omega = 32.93192 deg

thin_disc_scale_length.where: Sec. 5.1 margin box: 'Rt: 2.6±0.5 kpc, thin disk radial scalelength'

thin_disc_scale_height.where: Sec. 5.1 margin box: 'zt: 300±50 pc, thin disk vertical scalelength at R0'

thick_disc_scale_length.where: Sec. 5.1 margin box: 'RT: 2.0 ± 0.2 kpc, thick disk radial scalelength'

thick_disc_scale_height.where: Sec. 5.1 margin box: 'zT: 900±180 pc, thick disk vertical scalelength at R0'

bar_half_length.where: Sec. 4.3 margin box: 'Rlb: 5.0 ± 0.2 kpc, bar half-length' (long bar)

bar_angle.where: Sec. 4.2: 'The near side of the b/p bulge has its major axis in the first Galactic quadrant (0° < l < 90°). The bar angle between major axis and the Sun-Galactic center line ... is φbp = 27° ± 2°'; Sec. 4.3 gives the long bar 28°−33°

stellar_mass.where: Sec. 6.4: 'our estimate of the total stellar mass in the Milky Way is M⋆ = 5±1×10^10 Msun'

sun_height.where: Sec. 3.3: 'we adopt here the best estimate from the complete SDSS photometric survey, i.e. z0 = 25 ± 5 pc (Jurić et al. 2008)'

no_edge.where: Sec. 5.5: 'there is no strong evidence for a truncation to date in either old or young populations'

type.where: Sec. 4: the Galaxy's b/p bulge and long bar
